verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because RustDesk Server Pro documents a management API ([rustdesk-docs-12]). However, the evidence pack says nothing about API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation policy. The existence of an API is adjacent to this story and does not show versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
